cases.name: Lois J. Gift
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Lois was employed for more than 30 years at Conestoga Wood Specialties as a woodworker.
Lois loved her Grandson, Brayden and doing things with him. Lois loved the Beach. Lois loved getting together with family and friends and just having fun."
cases.relationship: Son / stepson / partner's son / child's partner
cases.narrative:
On 3/20/2023, her body was found by police during a welfare check.

Ephrata police detectives said Gift admitted that he got into a physical altercation with his mother as he attempted to take her purse and car keys without permission. That's when investigators say Zachary smothered and strangled Lois to death.
